title: Independence of a regular-sequence kernel from the regular-local presentation
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m_A)$ be a Noetherian complete local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring]. Let $q_0:P\twoheadrightarrow A$ and $q:Q\twoheadrightarrow A$ be surjective local homomorphisms from regular local rings $(P,\mathfrak m_P)$ and $(Q,\mathfrak m_Q)$ [def-weil-regular-scheme]. Then $\ker q_0$ is generated by a finite $P$-regular sequence contained in $\mathfrak m_P$ if and only if $\ker q$ is generated by a finite $Q$-regular sequence contained in $\mathfrak m_Q$. Empty sequences are allowed.
